answers.core: Loot generation of this type is commonly seen in games.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by computing floats for each item given considering its weight and rolling a random float with randf() multiples times. [Weighted Probability in docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/math/random_number_generation.html?#weighted-random-probability)

title: Add a method to get a random element with weighted probability (similar to `random.choices()` in Python)
